seo.title: Cursor at Your University | Walter Morales
seo.description: A collaboration proposal for Central American universities. Cursor Lab: guided hands-on sessions for students.

slides.headline:
Central American talent
competes at a disadvantage
items: The gap between what is taught and what the market demands keeps growing
Students learn theory without real-world workflows

slides.headline:
The tools exist —
practice is what's missing
slides.body: AI-powered IDEs are already the standard in professional teams. The earlier students master them, the better prepared they will be for the job market.

slides.headline: Walter Morales
slides.subtitle: Software Engineer · Cursor Ambassador El Salvador
slides.bio: Engineer with 6+ years of experience in software development, currently at SOUTHWORKS (AWS and Microsoft partners).

slides.headline: Cursor Lab
items: Guided 3-hour sessions with a working project at the end
For any technical level — even beginners
Led by a Cursor Ambassador with 6+ years of experience
